changes: Bind root path components with openat-style dir_fd + O_DIRECTORY + O_NOFOLLOW, preserving the supplied spelling without resolve(). Reject symlink components and parent traversal. Fail closed if required facilities are unavailable.
Enumerate names through open directory descriptors. No pathname-based recursive scandir or normal Path.open is used for original-file content.
Before and after bounded-to-observed-size file hashing, compare dev/inode/type/mode/size/mtime_ns/ctime_ns/nlink and final no-follow pathname binding. O_NONBLOCK avoids FIFO replacement hangs.

Check active ancestor descriptor identity and binding while walking. Detected ancestor changes abort this traversal, invalidate recorded hashes, leave unresolved statuses and incomplete/blocked coverage.
Keep stable schema1.1/inventory fields and deterministic bytes ordering. Builder version0.3.0; changed builder code participates in existing rebuild fingerprints.
verification: Each suite bounded at30sec/1MiB captured log; files at most synthetic small bytes; no model, network, CONFIG, GUI, secret store, or real personal files.
Direct os.read and Path.open guards reject the outside canary inode, rather than merely checking that its hash is absent.

Tests cover leaf/directory post-lstat swaps, same-size replacement, leaf/directory/root post-open swaps, same-inode write with mtime restoration, growth, active-directory membership change, FIFO replacement, missing OS capability, closed descriptors after success/OSError/unexpected exception, stable CLI output, unreadable directories.
Stable synthetic inventories and graph artifacts are checked by the existing path Validator; this is compatibility only, not validation-race certification.
git diff --check passed for owned product/test files.
compatibility_notes: The root and every supplied ancestor must be an actual directory, with no symlink aliases. On macOS, /var/folders/... fixtures need to intentionally use their canonical /private/var/folders/... root. No hidden resolve is reintroduced in the builder.

Root informed executor that F01 direct CLI fixtures needed two explicit canonical-root adjustments in the F01-owned test; bootstrap routes already canonicalize source. Other unexamined alias-based callers/fixtures may require the same explicit choice.

Public enumerate_entries(Path), sha256_file(Path), inventory_records, make_graph and CLI signatures remain usable; sha256_file accepts new internal keyword context. No Validator or bootstrap source edits made by this executor.
Unresolved directory nodes no longer expose a source hash as observed; root node is unresolved whenever coverage has errors.
residual_limits: This is not an atomic global filesystem snapshot. A completed file/directory can change after its final check, especially after its directory frame closes or during later publication. Answer-time freshness and final-generation revalidation remain separate F13 work.

No-follow confinement covers this builder only. validate_path_graph.py and other Readers/Validators still contain pathname reopen sequences and require separately owned repairs before any end-to-end race-safety claim.

Descriptor capability refers to the initially opened directory objects. Hard links, mount/privileged filesystem remapping, hostile filesystem metadata guarantees, and same-account compromise are not universal provenance protection.

No whole-tree item/byte/depth/deadline budget is implemented here. Name lists and records remain in memory, open descriptors scale with active depth, and blocking filesystem I/O can still require process supervision. F14 remains open.

Output-directory symlink handling, atomic publication of multiple output files, source/output overlap, unusual non-UTF8 filenames, and full app/model/GUI/package acceptance are not certified by this change.
Ancestor changes conservatively invalidate the entire observed generation, including otherwise unaffected files; this trades availability for explicit uncertainty.
rollback: Only inspect and reverse this isolated builder diff and owned new test/evidence files if directed. Do not reset the shared worktree, alter originals, or touch other agents/user changes.
proposed_next: Separate-context adversarial audit of the immutable artifact and source hashes; parent repeat selected synthetic tests and validate report. Executor does not self-approve.
